999008199.text:
あっ、見つけた！
おねーちゃん！　探していた素材だよ！

localizations.en: Found it! Sis, look—this is the ingredient we've been searching for!

999008199.text:
思ったより、たくさん咲いてるね。
これだけあれば、薬の調合には十分かな

localizations.en: There are way more than I expected. This should be more than enough for the medicine.

999008199.text: ……ここまで群生してるのは、初めて見た

localizations.en: ...I've never seen them growing in such a large cluster before.

999008199.text:
わたしも。ここは土の質も良さそうだし、
湿度も絶妙……やっぱり自然の力ってすごいなあ

localizations.en: Me neither. The soil quality here looks great too, and the humidity is just right... Nature really is something else.

999008199.text:
……この景色、いいわね。風の匂いも、
木々の揺れ方も。物語に書き残したくなる

localizations.en: ...What a view. The smell of the wind, the way the trees sway. I want to put all of it into words.

999008199.text: ユリエさん、旅の記録は順調ですか？

localizations.en: How is the travelogue coming along?

999008199.text:
ええ。言葉じゃ伝えきれないかもしれないけれど……
こういう素敵な景色を、私なりに文章にしているわ

localizations.en: Well enough. Some things are hard to capture in writing, but... I'm doing my best to put scenes like this into words in my own way.

999008199.text:
私、ここの土壌成分を調べてみたい。
薬草の成分変化も気になるし

localizations.en: I want to analyze the soil composition here. I'm curious how it affects the properties of the herbs.

999008199.text:
あ、わたしも。この花、育った土によって
香りが変わるんだって

localizations.en: Oh, me too! Apparently the scent of these flowers changes depending on the soil they grow in.

999008199.text:
……錬金術士ってやっぱりすごいなあ。
わたしは土まで調べようってならないもん

localizations.en: ...Alchemists really are amazing. I'd never think to study the soil itself.

999008199.text: 私には薬士の考えることも分かりません……

localizations.en: I'm afraid the way apothecaries think is beyond me as well...

999008199.text: ふふ。でも、おねーちゃんたちが楽しそうで嬉しいな

localizations.en: Hehe. But it makes me happy seeing everyone having so much fun.

999008199.text: ニオ、あなたも旅を楽しんでるのね

localizations.en: You're enjoying the journey too, aren't you, Nio?

999008199.text:
はい！　おねーちゃんと、みんなと
一緒に歩けるのが一番です

localizations.en: I am! Nothing makes me happier than getting to walk alongside Sis and everyone else.

999008199.text:
それにしても二人が一緒に旅してるの、珍しいよね。
ミルカちゃんも、お姉さんのお手伝いとか？

localizations.en: Still, it's unusual seeing you two traveling together. Are you helping your sister out, Miruca?

999008199.text: ……私は素材採取のついで

localizations.en: ...I'm gathering materials. She just happens to be there.

999008199.text:
ミルカはこんな感じだけど、
いざという時は頼りになるのよ

localizations.en: She may not show it, but when it really counts, she's the most dependable person I know.

999008199.text:
ふふ、そうなんですね！
わたしも、おねーちゃんのために頑張るから！

localizations.en: Hehe, that's great! I want to do my best for Sis too!

999008199.text:
ニオ……無理しないでね？
あまり一人で離れすぎたりもしちゃダメだよ？

localizations.en: Nio... don't push yourself too hard, okay? And please don't wander off on your own.

999008199.text:
もう、分かってるよ。大丈夫。
わたしだって、おねーちゃんの役に立ちたいんだもん

localizations.en: I know, I know. I'll be fine. I just want to be useful to you, that's all.

999008199.text:
大丈夫です、アーシャ。
私もいますから

localizations.en: You have nothing to worry about, Ayesha. I'll be right here.

999008199.text:
うん、ありがとう、リンカさん。
ニオも……ありがとう

localizations.en: Thank you, Linca. And Nio... thank you too.

999008199.text: うん！　えへへ

姉妹って、いいものね。
見ていると心が温かくなる

localizations.en: There's something wonderful about sisters. Just watching you two warms my heart.

999008199.text: ……そういうの、あまり言わないで。かゆいから

localizations.en: ...Don't say things like that. It's embarrassing.

999008199.text:
皆さん、そろそろ夜になりそうです。
目的のものも見つかりましたし、森を抜けましょう

localizations.en: It'll be nightfall soon, everyone. We found what we came for—let's make our way out of the forest.

999008199.text: お二人は、この後どこへ向かわれるのですか？

localizations.en: Where are you two headed after this?

999008199.text:
このまま東へ抜けて、クア州へ行くわ。
その後は、時計回りで各州を見て行くつもりよ

localizations.en: East through here, then on to Kur Province. After that, I plan to work my way around the other provinces clockwise.

999008199.text:
長い旅になりそうですね……
旅の無事を願っています

localizations.en: That's quite the journey ahead of you... I hope you travel safely.

999008199.text: ええ、ありがとう
